paragraphs.text: It starts with joy itself: consciousness dancing and singing. Then it names what getting the Lord actually means — seeing Him, and rarely: a vision fenced in for those who know the way in. Joy comes first in the verse, and only then its cause gets named: obtaining equals vision, rare by its very structure.
The direction never reverses: from rejoicing to definition, from dancing to the fenced vision of the covenant-knowers.
